title: mimesis.detection.v1
description: Face detection output for one panel. All coordinates are normalised 0-1 against the RECTIFIED PAINTING RECTANGLE (origin top-left, x right, y down), never against the source photograph. Produced by stage1/detect_faces.py.

painting_rect_px.description: Pixel size of the rectified raster. Present so the renderer can reason about the resolution the coordinates were measured at; it is NOT a projection target.

canvas_cm.description: Physical canvas size, [width_cm, height_cm]. Lets the renderer convert a normalised size into millimetres on the wall and drop overlay detail that cannot resolve.

source_photo_sha256.description: First 16 hex chars, so a re-run against a different photograph is detectable.

corner_method.description: How the canvas rectangle was established. 'manual' means a human placed the corners.

detectors.description: Per-detector model file, threshold and search strategy, recorded so any count in this file can be reproduced or challenged.

counts.description: Detector-side counts only. The three-way count table (detector / model claim / true) lives in reconcile.json, not here.

face_id.description: Stable id, e.g. A01. Ordered left-to-right by box x. Referenced by claims.json and score.json.

box.description: [x, y, w, h] normalised 0-1 to the painting rectangle.

detectors.description: Per-detector evidence for this face. Scores from different detectors are NOT comparable and are never averaged; a face detected by one detector only is a real and reportable state.

scale_hint.description: Which tile or scale produced the detection.

consensus.description: Sorted list of detector names that fired on this face. Length 1 means the detectors disagree about whether a face is here.

mesh_note.description: Why the landmark mesh is absent. A confident box with no converged mesh is a face-shaped region with no resolvable face geometry -- content, not an error.

landmarks.description: 478 MediaPipe FaceLandmarker points as [x, y, z], x/y normalised to the painting rectangle, z in the model's own relative depth units. null when mesh_ok is false. NEVER interpolated or filled in.
